rules: The original canonical message bytes and messageId are reused for every retry.
A retry never allocates a new senderSeq or messageId.
BATCH_CLOSED evidence is retained until the corresponding RESULT_READY is durably committed.
Superseded runtime sessions are cancelled explicitly and never retried into the active execution.
Exhaustion of a watchdog deadline interrupts the execution; it never converts an uncommitted draft into a formal result.
